name: The magnetized steel and scintillator calorimeters of the MINOS experiment

summary.plain: The published paper describing how the two MINOS detectors were built and how well they worked, used by both the original MINOS run and its MINOS+ continuation.
summary.technical: Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 596 (2008) 190 (arXiv:0805.3170): design, construction and performance of the magnetised steel-scintillator near (0.98 kt, Fermilab) and far (5.4 kt, Soudan) MINOS calorimeters.
